data.name: Ghani Chemworld Limited
data.description: Ghani ChemWorld Limited (the Company) was incorporated in Pakistan under the Companies Act, 2017 as a limited company on July 31, 2024. The principal line of business of the Company is to manufacture, produce, refine, process, formulate, acquire, convert, sell, distribute, buy, import, export, or otherwise deal in all types of chemicals, basic drugs, all types of acids, etc. The Company is a subsidiary of Ghani Global Holdings Limited.
